ModMetaData.name: Malay Themed Expansion - Fix
ModMetaData.author: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Repairs Malay Themed Expansion (Shanaki97) for RimWorld 1.6. Patch only - it adds no content of its own and contains none of the original mod's files.
What it fixes: - The two stoves (Dapur, Electric Dapur) failed to load entirely, because they carry a mod extension whose type cannot be resolved. That single fault also broke all eight Malay cooking recipes, which point at those stoves. - The Weave Spot and the dam haji board declared a recreation type but had no recreation giver, so no colonist could ever use them. The Weave Spot's recreation type is a ninth kind that no other mod provides, and it counted for nothing until now.
Known and left alone: one pawn extension is gated on a package id that no longer matches Vanilla Expanded Framework, so its faction-colour tinting never applies. It is cosmetic and it fails silently, so it is not worth the risk of turning on.
Load it after Malay Themed Expansion. Safe to add to an ongoing game.
